product_one_liner.value: Speak_ is an AI recruiting platform for hiring teams that scores and ranks applicants’ resumes against customizable job-specific signals to speed up screening.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage describes its customizable AI recruitment partner, resume review, and candidate ranking.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage has a public pricing section with Free, Pro ($199/month), and custom-priced Enterprise plans.

named_customers.notes: The homepage displays these names with customer testimonials/logos.

employee_band.notes: The LinkedIn company profile gives an 11–50 company-size range and identifies 18 employees; 18 falls in the 11–20 band.

hq_location.notes: The company profile lists Boulder, Colorado as headquarters.

founded_year.notes: The LinkedIn company profile states that Speak_ was founded in 2021.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index shows recruiting, interview-preparation, diversity, and candidate-experience content; it does not show at least two engineering posts about how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: The homepage provides product, pricing, FAQ, and contact information but no public documentation site, help center, or developer portal link.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: No Speak_-specific live careers page or job-board listings could be verified. The similarly named Speak language-learning company's job listings were excluded.

model_provider.notes: The public product, blog, and privacy-policy material reviewed did not identify the AI model or model provider used.

compliance_certs.notes: The company's public privacy/legal page was available, but no SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, or PCI DSS certification claim was found there.

last_funding.notes: The funding profile identifies a $1.3 million Seed round, last funded in December 2021.

raised_18mo.notes: The last funding date shown is December 2021, outside the 18-month window ending 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: No Speak_-specific live employer careers page or job-board listing was found; unrelated roles for the separate Speak language-learning company were excluded.

launched_6mo.notes: The readable company blog index contains no product or major-feature launch announcement in the six months before 2026-11-09; its posts are older editorial/recruiting content.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The small team page identifies the co-founders and team but shows no C-level or VP-level hire in the period; no leadership departure announcement was found.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The readable product page names ATS integrations (Greenhouse, Ashby, Workable, and Lever), but no CRM or sales/marketing system.
